pattern.name: Product Demo + Features
pattern.sections: Hero > Product video/mockup (center) > Feature breakdown per section > Comparison (optional) > CTA
pattern.color_strategy: Video surround: Brand color overlay. Features: Icon color #0080FF. Text: Dark #222
pattern.conversion: Use an interactive demo only when it explains value better than static media. Provide captions, transcript, visible play/pause controls, and a non-video fallback; do not autoplay under reduced motion. Pause media when offscreen or hidden and keep the final product state available as static content.
